# cloudaxion_firewall (Resource)

A stateful L4 firewall, attachable to virtual machines with `cloudaxion_firewall_attachment`.

Rules are declared inline. The API replaces the whole rule set on update, so the `rule` blocks are the complete definition — a rule removed from configuration is removed from the firewall.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudaxion_firewall" "control_plane" {
  name        = "k8s-control-plane"
  description = "Kubernetes API and node-to-node traffic"

  rule {
    protocol           = "tcp"
    direction          = "inbound"
    port_start         = 6443
    port_end           = 6443
    endpoint_spec_type = "ip_prefixes"
    endpoint_spec      = ["10.0.0.0/8"]
  }

  # A single port: omit port_end and the API normalises it to port_start.
  rule {
    protocol           = "tcp"
    direction          = "inbound"
    port_start         = 22
    endpoint_spec_type = "ip_prefixes"
    endpoint_spec      = ["203.0.113.0/24"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the firewall.

### Optional

- `billing_account_id` (Number) Billing account. Defaults to the provider's `billing_account_id`.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `location` (String) Location slug. Defaults to the provider's `location`.
- `rule` (Block List) A traffic rule. Order is not significant to the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp reported by the API.
- `id` (String) Firewall UUID.

<a id="nestedblock--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `direction` (String) Traffic direction: `inbound` or `outbound`.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol: `tcp`, `udp` or `icmp`.

Optional:

- `endpoint_spec` (List of String) IP addresses or CIDR blocks the rule applies to. Only meaningful when `endpoint_spec_type` is `ip_prefixes`; ignored otherwise.
- `endpoint_spec_type` (String) `any` to match every address, or `ip_prefixes` to restrict to the addresses in `endpoint_spec`.
- `port_end` (Number) Last port in the range. Omit for a single port: the API then **normalises it to `port_start`** and returns that, which is why this attribute is computed as well as optional.
- `port_start` (Number) First port in the range, 1–65535. **Omit to match every port** — that is what the API means by a null value.

Read-Only:

- `uuid` (String) Rule UUID assigned by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cloudaxion_firewall.control_plane tun01/1449c7e2-0f8f-42df-90d6-c1f726fbb55b
```
